text:
olivia_partnerships: Quick sync — posted notes from the vendor call. Need a decision on regional fallback priority for H100/H200/B200, MI300 and Gaudi before EOD Fri. US-E vs US-W capacity tradeoffs are real.
vikram_shah: thanks — can you paste the short version? long doc later is fine. :hourglass: 
olivia_partnerships: TL;DR: 1) H100 primary in US-E, H200 burst in US-W; 2) MI300 scheduling currently delayed ~3w in APAC, recommend routing APAC -> crosscloud MI300 fallbacks to GCP for Q4 canary; 3) Gaudi availability spotty in EU- Central — suggest reserve B200 as fallback for certain SKUs.
alex_kim: to be concrete — are we proposing automatic reroute at capacity threshold or manual runbook?
maria_gonzalez: +1 on automated policy but need a limit to avoid cross-region latency spikes. suggest: auto-reroute if queue_time > 250ms AND region_util > 85% for 2m.
jess_product: Product ask: if we reroute MI300->GCP in APAC, what are the billing / marketplace implications? need legal signoff for partner revenue share.
olivia_partnerships: jess_product good call — partners asked for a pre-approved pricing delta. we can use existing marketplace surcharge template but need partner opt-in. pinged legal.
nvidia_pm_bot: FYI — vendor-side firmware embargo lifts 2026-06-12 for H200 microcode. any press/announce windows should not reference firmware details before that. :no_entry_sign: 
vikram_shah: noted. For canaries: propose small fleets in us-east-1 + gp2 region (non-prod) with `--replicas 4` for H100, and GA canary for H200 in us-west-2.
alex_kim: ops checklist draft: ```
- build canary images (sha: c3f2a1)
- test model latency @ 2k seq
- run load: 10k reqs/5m
- verify KV cache warmup < 30s
```
maria_gonzalez: also add: confirm quantization profile for B200 models — last time we saw quality drift at 4-bit aggressive.
jess_product: communication timeline proposal: week 1 internal partner comms, week 2 embargoed SI previews (NDAs), week 3 public marketplace listing + blog. thoughts?
olivia_partnerships: sounds reasonable. small change: flip week2/3 for any vendor that requests staggered press. add an "embargo matrix" to the doc.
nvidia_pm_bot: NVIDIA side: we can support staging images earlier but partner PR needs a 48h pre-announce window.
vikram_shah: ops question — what's our fallback mapping table? I sketched one: ```
US-E: H100 -> H200 (burst) -> B200
US-W: H200 -> H100 (if available) -> B200
EMEA: Gaudi -> B200 -> MI300 (crosscloud)
APAC: MI300 -> GCP-MI300 -> H200 (if compatible)
```
alex_kim: compatibility note: MI300 model checkpoint format differs slightly — runtime needs conversion step. that adds ~30s to cold-starts unless we warm KV.
maria_gonzalez: can we pre-convert critical checkpoints during off-peak? ops could run a nightly conversion job to keep hot cache images.
jess_product: dependencies for SI integration: cert matrix (network ports, image sigs), playbook for fallbacks, and test prompts for quality regression. I'll assemble.
olivia_partnerships: action items: @vikram_shah to create canary infra by Tue, @alex_kim to prototype conversion job, @jess_product to draft comms/embargo matrix, @maria_gonzalez to define routing thresholds. I'll chase legal for pricing delta.
vikram_shah: got it — will create infra ticket and ping infra-sre.
alex_kim: will prototype, estimate 2 days.
maria_gonzalez: drafting thresholds now, will share in channel.
jess_product: starting comms doc now.
olivia_partnerships: thanks all. I'll update the master sheet and schedule a 30min follow-up Wed morning. :calendar: 
deploy-bot: Canary clusters provisioned: us-east-1/h100-canary (4 nodes), us-west-2/h200-canary (4 nodes). Logs: http://internal.logs/canary/4923210000
vikram_shah: excellent — if anyone hits issues in canary, drop errors here.
alex_kim: saw one conversion error in logs (checkpoint header mismatch) — filing bug #4281.
maria_gonzalez: noted. keeping an eye on quality metrics.
jess_product: if legal approves pricing delta today, I can move week 2 -> week 3 timeline earlier.
olivia_partnerships: copy. closing thread for now — will reopen after Wed sync. :white_check_mark:
